result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion. However, termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Customer data, potentially disrupting continuing Service Option Attachments and contradicting the clause’s existing partial-termination structure. It should limit return and deletion to data associated with the terminated attachment unless the entire Agreement terminates.
